mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies near the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 73 degrees and an air quality index of 51.

The City of Verona has updated its engineering reports for public review, and residents can also take advantage of the free tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center to ride along the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is plenty to do with the Girls Try Hockey event happening today at the Verona Ice Arena and live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard also taking place today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In police news, on Thursday, a local officer conducted a traffic stop for a vehicle missing its taillights and driving on a flat tire, resulting in an O W I arrest for the driver.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy their featured flavor, Snickers Swirl, and know that they are open for you until 10 PM.
